rows.quote: To address this gap, we performed antibody-based proteomic profiling using Olink technology [11] across four key cardiometabolic tissues (liver, skeletal muscle, aorta and mammary artery), assaying 1,242 samples from 284 patients in the Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Engineering Task (STARNET) cohort [14,15].
rows.dataset_named_in_source: Stockholm-Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Engineering Task (STARNET) cohort
rows.coder_note: Step 3 of the decision order (rules C and C2): the authors' own Olink tissue proteomic profiling and pQTL analysis in the STARNET cohort, defined by a described measurement procedure; the pqtl side of the dictionary has no STARNET row under any release, and refs 14 and 15 are the source of no dictionary row, so rule C5 gives no code. No accession, so rule C4 does not apply.
